responseSummary.summary: Built from 2 resolved Qloo entities and 16 cross-category affinity signals.

plan.title: Familiar opening
plan.action: Start with “Ella Fitzgerald” as the familiar cue, then branch toward “Jazz”; keep the pace gentle and low-pressure. Facilitator cue: Offer a short, appropriately licensed music excerpt, or describe the rhythm if audio is unavailable. Ask: “Would you like another sound like this, or something different?” Invite spoken or nonverbal answers, and allow anyone to pass.
plan.why: The session starts from “Ella Fitzgerald” and uses Qloo-ranked “Jazz” as adjacent memory/conversation evidence.

plan.title: Memory bridge
plan.action: Bridge from “Roman Holiday” into “Romance” with a scene, photo, lyric, headline, or memory prompt. Keep it for a small group with room for individual responses. Facilitator cue: Describe a gentle moment of connection in a film or story. Ask: “What makes that scene feel welcoming?” Avoid pressing anyone for personal memories. Invite spoken or nonverbal answers, and allow anyone to pass.
plan.why: Qloo-ranked “Romance” provides a specific adjacent bridge instead of a generic nostalgia prompt.

plan.title: Conversation choice
plan.action: Offer two or three conversation directions connected to “swing,” and let participants choose. Facilitator cue: Offer a short, appropriately licensed music excerpt, or describe the rhythm if audio is unavailable. Ask: “Would you like another sound like this, or something different?” Invite spoken or nonverbal answers, and allow anyone to pass.
plan.why: “swing” extends the known tastes while preserving participant choice.

plan.title: Recall & close
plan.action: Use “Musical” for one final memory or preference prompt, then ask what should return next time. Facilitator cue: Offer a short, appropriately licensed music excerpt, or describe the rhythm if audio is unavailable. Ask: “Would you like another sound like this, or something different?” Invite spoken or nonverbal answers, and allow anyone to pass.
plan.why: “Musical” keeps the close inside the Qloo-grounded memory/conversation neighborhood.

agentTrace.detail: Resolved 2 cultural anchors into Qloo entity evidence; 2 exact-name and 0 explicitly confirmed top-result match(es).
Selected 4 Qloo-ranked genre signals across 2 activity-relevant family/families; interleaved categories without treating their scores as a shared global ranking.
Mapped the selected signals into a 30-minute calm session for a small-group setting.
Attached visible rationales. Qloo explainability was requested, but this response did not include attribution metadata.

limitations: Qloo cultural affinities are aggregate signals, not personal preferences or a clinical determination.
This captures a public live response at one timestamp; tags and results may change on later runs.
Numeric scores from separate genre families are not converted into a shared confidence mean.
Facilitator cues are authored deterministic guidance, not claims that Qloo wrote the activity.
The previous unfavorable synthetic evaluation and zero validated real-user responses remain disclosed.
